title: Lost Mary BM600 Blue Razz Ice Prefilled Vape Pods 20mg - 2PK
description: Blue Razz Ice brings together the sweet, lively tang of Blue Raspberry with a streak of cool Menthol. The rich dark berry slushy flavour bursts with sharp, juicy sweetness on the inhale, followed by a brisk, refreshing exhale that adds a bracing lift on the exhale. It’s a punchy yet balanced blend that’s perfect for vapers who enjoy vibrant fruit with an icy-cool edge. Designed for use with the Lost Mary BM600 Prefilled Pod Kit, these replacement pods offer a seamless way to continue enjoying your favourite Lost Mary flavours without the need to replace the entire device. Each twin pack includes two prefilled 2ml pods, each containing 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid for a smooth, satisfying MTL (mouth-to-lung) vape and rapid nicotine delivery. Each pod delivers up to 600 puffs, depending on individual vaping habits. Once depleted, simply replace the pod with a fresh one to keep your vape session going with minimal effort.
